query: What missing-data approach will be primary for item nonresponse and follow-up attrition (FIML vs multiple imputation), and what sensitivity analyses will we run?

response.query: What missing-data approach will be primary for item nonresponse and follow-up attrition (FIML vs multiple imputation), and what sensitivity analyses will we run?
response.answer: For item nonresponse and follow-up attrition, Full Information Maximum Likelihood (FIML) is typically primary. Sensitivity analyses will include multiple imputation comparisons.
